description: Department of Labour - Notifying that the Cost of Living Index Number for the Cocoa, Cardamom and Pepper Growing and Manufacturing Trade for the Month of June 2016 being 117.5, the Special Allowance in respect of a normal working day in the Month of July 2016 will be Rs. 669.42
reasoning: This gazette notification announces a special allowance for workers in specific agricultural trades based on cost of living adjustments. It falls under public service administration as it deals with wage regulations, worker benefits, and service conditions for employees in designated sectors, issued by the Commissioner General of Labour under the Wages Boards Ordinance.
